headline: Cal Poly Pomona and Cal State LA both lose
dek: Cal Poly Pomona and Cal State LA were both beaten away from home on the same afternoon, against non-conference opposition. For Pomona it was only a third defeat all season; Cal State LA had arrived off consecutive wins over UC Merced.
